log.notes_to_self: Day 1: kill all 11 in afternoon (10 quick, 1 timed). Afternoon is optimal for concealing routine: night workers, students and at-home people all free, retaining 55% of population; avoid morning deaths which can eliminate students. Goal is sustained 40+ kills per rolling 5 days for 4x scoring, but survival matters for future points. Exactly 2 of the 5 nonnational source kinds are inaccessible to this L; their deaths never yield successful traces, including cross-reported victims touching them. Need infer inaccessible sources from cumulative trace counts and pool changes, eventually emphasize those sources and avoid fully exposing all 3 accessible dimensions. With afternoon routine constraint, 3 exact accessible dimensions reduce pool to 688 or 859 and trigger capture; 2 leave at least 2750. Cross-reporting can weaken constraints. No source has more than 2 known victims killed yet, so initial source activation is unlikely. National kills give no source evidence. Major/minor has no stated scoring difference. Track rolling totals and use feedback to balance early multiplier ramp against identification risk.

Day 1 killed all 11, all afternoon; feedback pool 60000 (actual routine-only pool 55000), 2 nonnational traces. Day 2 also kill all 11 afternoon, 10 quick + national timed. Total kills after today 22; each nonnational source has 4 victims killed cumulatively. Afternoon preserves night workers, students, home (55%); never add morning deaths unnecessarily. Two of five source kinds inaccessible, unknown; cross-report touching either prevents successful tracing. Three successful traces sharing a place activate its evidence; traces then impose ORs over all reported outlets. Three fully exposed accessible dimensions with routine constraint imply 688 or 859 suspects, fatal; two imply at least 2750. Day 2 risk small because only 2 traces existed after day 1, but repeated all-source killing becomes dangerous soon. Use next conference to reassess: cumulative trace count and pool drop indicate how much evidence has activated. Must consider restricting sources rather than blindly pursuing all 11. Sustaining 8+ kills/day reaches 40 rolling deaths and 4x, but 7/day yields 2x and can be preferable if safer. National always safe. Major/minor has no stated relevance. Rolling kills d1=11,d2=11; points expected 22 before conference. Preserve survival for earning future points, not as an end in itself; capture halves total and ends game.

After d2: 22 points, 22 kills, pool 60000 (routine-only actual 55000), only 3 cumulative nonnational successful traces; no source evidence visibly activated. D3 kill all 11 afternoon, national timed and other 10 quick. This gives 33 rolling kills and 2x for all today's kills, so 44 total points if uncaught. Three accessible source kinds, two inaccessible, unknown. Tracing probability 50%, but cross-report touching inaccessible kind blocks entire trace. Source activates after 3 successful traces sharing it, imposing ORs for reported outlets. Only 3 traces through d2 means immediate three-source activation risk remains relatively low; full harvest today also provides diagnostic feedback. Reassess after d3 rather than automatically killing everything indefinitely. With afternoon-only deaths routine pool remains 55% (night workers+students+home); avoid morning, which can remove students. Two fully identified source kinds leave >=2750 suspects; three leave 688 or 859 and cause capture. Need infer inaccessible sources through pool changes and trace-count increments, eventually stop at least one accessible kind before it activates. Restricting to four source kinds gives 9 kills/day, sustaining 4x, if omitted kind is accessible and its earlier traces never activate; otherwise dangerous. Restricting to three gives 7/day, sustaining 2x, safer but less profitable. Gazette evidence is more constraining than other kinds. National always safe; major/minor has no stated relevance. Capture at <=1000 ends game and halves total points; survival only matters for further earnings. Rolling kills d1=11,d2=11,d3=11. All daily kills get multiplier based on final rolling total, not entry order. Tomorrow >=7 kills reaches 40 rolling and 4x.

Likely one outlet activated with 3 traces, leaving only1 trace elsewhere. Rounded10000 cannot distinguish gazette-only11000 from other single-source13750, or some OR complications. If gazette accessible and not already activated, avoiding it may prevent third-source activation; if inaccessible or already activated this does not protect us long term. Cross-reports may still introduce gazette evidence. Reassess trace increment and pool tomorrow; consider controlled outlet probing rather than blindly harvest all. Afternoon-only deaths preserve night workers+students+home =55%; avoid morning. Two simple source constraints leave2750 or3438 suspects; three leave688 or859, capture <=1000 halves points and ends game. All deaths independently50% trace attempts; trace fails if ANY reporting kind inaccessible. National entirely safe. Successfully traced victim imposes OR over its outlets only once3 traces share an outlet. Major/minor no stated significance. Can use10 quick+2 timed/day, all afternoon; with9 kills use quick throughout. Pool feedback rounded1 significant figure. Future aim maximize points, not survival itself; need preserve earning runway while sustaining >=40 deaths/5days.
